title: Hierarchical Forecast Reconciliation for Urban Rail Transit Demand Prediction under Operational Disruptions
abstract: arXiv:2606.07044v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurate and coherent passenger demand forecasting is essential for Urban Rail Transit (URT) operations. Passenger demand is hierarchical: origin--destination (OD) flows aggregate to station-level inflows and outflows through conservation constraints. However, independently generated station- and OD-level forecasts may violate these constraints and limit information sharing across levels. This paper develops a hierarchical forecast reconciliation framework for joint station- and OD-level demand prediction. A neural Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR) maps incoherent base forecasts to coherent predictions with exact structural consistency by construction. We benchmark FCR against classical and machine-learning reconciliation methods using one year of Rejsekort smart-card and Banedanmark operational data from a 12-station Copenhagen S-train subnetwork, covering one-step, multi-step, and disruption forecasting. translated_title: 运营中断下城市轨道交通需求预测的层级预测协调方法
translated_abstract: 准确且协调一致的客流需求预测对城市轨道交通（URT）运营至关重要。客流需求具有层级结构：起讫点（OD）客流通过守恒约束汇聚为车站级的进出站流量。然而，独立生成的车站级与OD级预测可能违反这些约束，并限制各层级之间的信息共享。本文开发了一个用于车站级与OD级联合需求预测的层级预测协调框架。一种基于神经网络的全连接协调器（FCR）将不协调的基础预测映射为在构造上即具有精确结构一致性的协调预测。我们使用来自哥本哈根S-tog（市郊铁路）12个车站子网络一年的Rejsekort交通卡数据和Banedanmark运营数据，在单步预测、多步预测和运营中断预测场景下，将FCR与经典方法及机器学习协调方法进行基准比较，同时我们还与一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于神经网络全连接协调器（FCR）的层级预测协调框架，从构造上保证车站级与OD级客流预测的结构一致性，并在哥本哈根S-tog一年的真实数据上，于单步、多步及运营中断预测场景下优于经典与机器学习协调方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical forecast reconciliation framework with a neural Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR) that guarantees exact structural consistency between station- and OD-level demand predictions by construction, outperforming classical and machine-learning reconciliation methods on one year of Copenhagen S-train data across one-step, multi-step, and disruption forecasting scenarios.
